motivation: Close implementation-level authority gaps found by independent mathematical review after row freeze but before any v2.1 validation model forward. This adds fail-closed bindings and cannot relax a selector, gate, comparison, or claim.

site1_full_native_contexts.rule: Run and serialize distinct full-native MLP1 adequacy controls under frozen T0 and frozen S0 upstream states. Each record binds its context label, selected upstream-state logical hash, mapped-validation document identity, scorer currency, and measurement hash. Both must independently pass the registered scale-aware physical, poison, and unified row-CE gates. Full-native capture and scored-arm counters have exact site keys 0,1,2 and exact 24-batch totals: site0 capture {0:24,1:0,2:0}, site0 scored {0:0,1:24,2:0}; site1 capture {0:0,1:24,2:0}, site1 scored {0:0,1:0,2:0}. A maximum-over-context summary alone is insufficient.
site1_full_native_contexts.mean_context: M0 is a nondeployable mean comparator and does not train or select an A-E MLP1 bank; no third full-native selection control is required.

preselector_ledger_binding.site0: After both complete true-site0 and shuffle-site0 108-cell banks and their mean/full-native controls are scored, atomically write and reload an external nonauthorizing site0 candidate/control/diagnostic ledger artifact and receipt before either selector is called. Diagnostics bind the fixed fit permutation, exact capture-hash key schema, context-local teacher denominator and copy baseline sufficient statistics, and poison-complete arm-indexed call counters for every capture, teacher, baseline, and all 108 true plus all 108 shuffle candidate scorings.
preselector_ledger_binding.site1: After both complete context-local true-site1 and shuffle-site1 108-cell banks, M1, and both context-specific full-native controls are scored, atomically write and reload an external nonauthorizing site1 candidate/control/diagnostic ledger artifact and receipt before either selector is called. Diagnostics separately bind T0/S0 upstream hashes, the identical fixed permutation, exact capture-hash key schema, teacher denominator and copy baseline sufficient statistics, and poison-complete arm-indexed call counters for every capture, teacher, baseline, and all 108 true plus all 108 shuffle candidate scorings.
preselector_ledger_binding.fixed_shuffle_identity: For both stage artifacts, recompute the only permitted shuffle index by applying state_complete_compiler_fit_v2.document_block_permutation to the ordered compiler_fit_v21 provenance document_id list with FIT_SEED=271828, then expand each row to its 64 coefficient-capture positions with expand_capture_permutation. Both stages must serialize the exact SHA256 of that expanded int64 tensor; an arbitrary well-formed digest or a different permutation is forbidden.
preselector_ledger_binding.counter_contract: All call-counter records have the exact site keys 0,1,2. With 480 fit rows and 192 validation rows at batch size 8, site0 fit captures are exactly {0:60,1:60,2:0}, site0 validation captures {0:24,1:0,2:0}, OON teachers {0:24,1:24,2:0}, NON baselines and every site0 candidate {0:0,1:24,2:0}. Under either frozen T0 or S0, site1 fit captures are {0:0,1:60,2:0}, site1 validation captures and T0/S0-O1 teachers {0:0,1:24,2:0}, while T0/S0-N1 baselines and every site1 candidate are {0:0,1:0,2:0}. MLP2 is always zero. The external validator requires one exact counter for every candidate name in each complete ledger.
preselector_ledger_binding.mean_site1_provenance: Regenerate a separate M0-to-site1 fit capture on compiler_fit_v21. Bind its exact capture hash, exact {0:0,1:60,2:0} poison-complete counter, float64 p1 coefficient sum [64] and SHA256, and exact count 480*64=30720. Recompute the float32 mean from sum/count and require exact equality with the serialized M1 constant bias. M1 cannot reuse a T0 or S0 capture or be accepted merely because its grammar says fit_mean_control.
preselector_ledger_binding.final_bundle: The program bundle and final-unlock receipt bind both external artifacts and receipts by canonical path, SHA256, and byte count. The reloaded external ledgers must equal the ledgers embedded in the final program bundle.
preselector_ledger_binding.failure: Any selector failure preserves its external ledger artifact/receipt and writes no downstream training or final-scoring authority.

strata_derivation.token_frequency: Count compiler_fit_v21 target token ids at scored model-target indices 64..255, exactly raw row columns 65:257. Assign compiler_validation_v21 targets at the identical positions with torch.bucketize(right=True) to the prospectively fixed count boundaries [1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128]. Store only hashes of the length-50257 fit count vector and validation assignment tensor plus aggregate bin counts; recompute all hashes and counts from the role caches before final unlock.
strata_derivation.causal_weights: Under frozen T0 and on mapped validation, for direction j define omission_loss_j as mean over source rows of CE(omit j from the full projected MLP1 oracle)-CE(full projected MLP1 oracle), with each row CE the mean over scored target indices 64..255 in unified CUDA float32 and float64 row/aggregate arithmetic. Define moment_j from the sum of squared p1_j on the identical T0 validation coefficient-capture positions. There are exactly 192*64=12288 such coefficient-capture positions; this is distinct from the 192*192=36864 scored CE targets. Store full-oracle row CE [192], all omit-row CE [64,192], their tensor hashes, p-square sums [64], the exact count 12288, T0 selected-state hash, validation identity, scorer/call counters, and recomputed omission losses/moments. Omission losses, second moments, raw ratios, and the quantile floor remain float64. Let raw_j=abs(loss_j)/max(moment_j,1e-12); let floor be torch.quantile(strictly-positive float64 raw,.05,interpolation=linear); weight_j=max(raw_j,floor), normalized to mean one; only the final normalized weights are serialized float32. Recompute every aggregate and hash before final unlock.
strata_derivation.guardrail: These validation-frozen strata are collateral/reporting definitions only and cannot alter either site selector.
